name: Creature On-Kill Reputation
description: Reputation rewarded to players for killing a creature: up to two factions with reputation amount, a maximum standing cap, and optional team-wide (whole group/raid regardless of tap) or team-dependent (faction 1 for Alliance, faction 2 for Horde) behavior.

fields.name: Reward Faction 1
fields.help: faction.dbc id of the first rewarded faction. 0 = none.

fields.name: Reward Faction 2
fields.help: faction.dbc id of the second rewarded faction. 0 = none.

fields.name: Max Standing 1
fields.help: Reputation rank cap for faction 1: no reputation is given once the player reached this standing.

fields.name: Is Team Award 1
fields.help: If 1, reputation with faction 1 is awarded to the whole team of the faction's team parent.

fields.name: Reward Value 1
fields.help: Amount of reputation given for faction 1 (can be negative).

fields.name: Max Standing 2
fields.help: Reputation rank cap for faction 2: no reputation is given once the player reached this standing.

fields.name: Is Team Award 2
fields.help: If 1, reputation with faction 2 is awarded to the whole team of the faction's team parent.

fields.name: Reward Value 2
fields.help: Amount of reputation given for faction 2 (can be negative).

fields.name: Team Dependent
fields.help: If 1, Alliance players are rewarded only with faction 1 and Horde players only with faction 2.
